observations: Original 'fat' model PlayStation 4 console wrapped in plastic film.
A transparent/clear DualShock 4 wireless controller inside a retail box.
Console is powered on and connected to a curved monitor.
The screen shows a game library including 'EA SPORTS FC 27 By Haider Kiara', 'God of War Ragnarok', and 'GTA V'.
The 'FC 27' title is a known mod for jailbroken (HEN) consoles, as the official series is currently at FC 24/25.
A custom anime theme is visible on the home screen.
The plastic wrap has '13.02 WITH GAMES' written on it in red marker.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the thick, angular chassis of the original PS4 model.
photo 1 and 2 show a game icon labeled 'EA SPORTS FC 27', though this is a software mod.
This depends on the seller's ability to install software, which cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The console appears to be jailbroken (HEN), which prevents online play on PSN.
risks.proof: A photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the firmware version.

risks.risk: The controller in the box may be a third-party clone rather than an original Sony unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sticker on the back of the controller.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive capacity is unknown.
The optical disc drive may be faulty, common in older 'fat' models.
risks.proof: A video showing a physical disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a non-functional disc drive.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the Storage screen showing the HDD capacity.
Photo of the back of the controller to verify authenticity.
Video of the console loading a physical game disc.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a first-generation PlayStation 4. While the 'FC 27' mod strongly suggests a jailbroken system, it can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a functional 500GB unit with a clone controller.
